title: 第9章 脚底抹油第10章 偷剑贼
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
他两指一点，纸条凭空飞到他面前，稳稳定住。
纸条上的字迹歪歪扭扭：
想找人，跟狗来。
没有署名，没有多余的废话，他眼底闪过一抹杀意，捏着剑的手收紧两分。
鹤隐舟指尖一动，纸条化作灰烬，从他指缝间飘散，落在夜风里。
富贵摇了摇尾巴，转身一瘸一拐地跑进了小巷，鹤隐舟抬腿跟了上去。
他面无表情，步伐不快不慢，和那只瘸腿狗保持着一种诡异的默契距离。
夜风从巷口灌进来，带来远处街头的灯火和喧嚣声。
富贵跑着跑着突然停了下来，蹲在巷子深处一块空地上，回头看了他一眼，乖乖地趴下了。
任务完成。
鹤隐舟脚步微顿，目光扫过四周。
巷子很窄，两侧是高高的院墙，空气里残留着一丝淡淡的灵力波动。
他下意识想后退，抬起脚，但再次落下去时像是踩进了一团浆糊里。
低头一看，脚下的青石板已经变成了一滩发着荧光，黏糊糊，正在往上爬的奇怪东西。
他面无表情地试着抬脚。
抬不动。
又试了试另一只脚。
也抬不动。
他整个人像是被一桶强力胶水糊在了地上，从脚底板到脚踝，从脚踝到小腿，那滩发着荧光的东西正在以一种令人头皮发麻的速度往上蔓延。
鹤隐舟：“……”

他深吸一口气，调动体内灵力，试图挣脱。
灵力刚涌到脚底，那滩荧光东西猛地亮了一下。
“噗嗤……”
像有人放了个屁。
这不是普通的困阵，而是专门恶心人的困阵。
鹤隐舟闭上眼睛，额角青筋跳了一下，这种稀奇古怪的东西宁楚有并不稀奇。
巷子深处，一个佝偻的身影从阴影里走了出来。
那人穿着一件宽大的黑色斗篷，从头裹到脚，看不出身形，看不清面容。
走路的姿势像一个八旬老妪，弯着腰，拄着拐杖，一步一步往前挪，看着随时都可能散架。
老妪挪到了他面前，距离三步远的地方停了下来。
她缓缓抬头露出一张布满皱纹的脸，皱纹多得能夹死蚊子，眼皮耷拉着，眼珠子浑浊发黄，嘴里似乎还缺了几颗牙，嘴唇瘪进去，整张脸看起来像是被揉皱的纸团又重新展开。
鹤隐舟只看了一眼便移开视线，他并不在意。
如今动弹不得，脚底下的荧光膏已经爬到了膝盖，面前站着一个来历不明的老太婆，手无寸铁，灵力波动几乎为零，看着就像是一个走错片场的普通老人。
但直觉告诉他，不对。
老妪走到了他右手边停住，浑浊的老眼正直直地盯着他手里的剑。
宁楚伸出一双枯瘦的，布满老年斑的手，颤巍巍地伸向破云。
鹤隐舟的眼神冷了下来，“你敢。”
她的手顿了一下，旋即猛地握住了破云的剑柄，一用力，把剑从他手里抽了出来。
鹤隐舟想握紧，但他动不了。
content_en:
He pointed two fingers, and the note flew to him out of thin air and stabilized.
The handwriting on the note is crooked:
If you want to find someone, come with the dog.
There was no signature, no unnecessary nonsense, a flash of killing intent flashed in his eyes, and the hand holding the sword tightened two points.
He Yinzhou moved his fingertips, and the note turned into ashes, drifting from between his fingers and falling into the night wind.
Fugui shook his tail, turned around and limped into the alley, and He Yinzhou lifted his legs to follow.
His face was expressionless, his pace was neither fast nor slow, and he maintained a strange tacit understanding of distance from the lame dog.
The night wind blew in from the alley, bringing with it the lights and noise of the distant streets.
Fugui suddenly stopped while running, squatted in an open space deep in the alley, looked back at him, and lay down obediently.
Mission accomplished.
He Yinzhou paused slightly and glanced around.
The alley is very narrow, with high courtyard walls on both sides, and there is a faint spiritual energy fluctuation in the air.
He subconsciously wanted to step back and lift his feet, but when he fell down again, he seemed to have stepped into a ball of mud.
When I looked down, I saw that the bluestone slab under my feet had turned into a puddle of fluorescent, sticky, strange things that were crawling up.
He tried to lift his feet expressionlessly.
Can't lift it.
Tried the other foot.
Can't lift it either.
His entire body seemed to be stuck to the ground with a bucket of strong glue. From the soles of his feet to his ankles, and from his ankles to his calves, the fluorescent substance was spreading upwards at a numbing speed.
He Yinzhou: "..."
He took a deep breath, mobilized his spiritual power, and tried to break free.
As soon as the spiritual power surged into the soles of his feet, the fluorescent thing suddenly lit up.
"Pfft..."
Like someone farted.
This is not an ordinary trapped formation, but a specifically disgusting trapped formation.
He Yinzhou closed his eyes, and the veins on his forehead twitched. It was not unusual for Ning Chu to have such weird things.
Deep in the alley, a rickety figure walked out of the shadows.
The man wore a large black cloak that covered him from head to toe. His figure and face could not be seen clearly.
She walked like an eighty-year-old woman, bent over and leaning on a cane, moving forward step by step, looking like she might fall apart at any time.
The old woman moved in front of him and stopped three steps away.
She slowly raised her head to reveal a face full of wrinkles, with so many wrinkles that they could trap mosquitoes. Her eyelids were droopy, her eyeballs were cloudy and yellow, and there seemed to be a few teeth missing in her mouth. Her lips were sunk in, and the whole face looked like a crumpled paper ball that had been unfolded again.
He Yinzhou only glanced at it and looked away. He didn't care.
Now unable to move, the fluorescent ointment under her feet has reached her knees. Standing in front of her is an old woman of unknown origin. She is unarmed and has almost zero spiritual power fluctuations. She looks like an ordinary old man who has walked into the wrong set.
But his intuition told him that it was wrong.
The old woman walked to his right and stopped, her cloudy old eyes staring directly at the sword in his hand.
Ning Chu stretched out a pair of skinny hands covered with age spots, tremblingly reaching towards Poyun.
He Yinzhou's eyes turned cold, "How dare you."
Her hand paused for a moment, and then she suddenly grasped the hilt of Poyun's sword, and with a strong force, she pulled the sword out of his hand.
He Yinzhou wanted to tighten his grip, but he couldn't move.
